You probably know somebody who swears they will never work in government and without asking another question you know exactly what they mean.

But what if it didn't have to be that way?

A few years ago I started an experimental team in the Singapore government.
几年前，我在新加坡政府成立了一个实验团队。
The idea was simple.
这个想法很简单。
Instead of the usual top-down decision-making, we built small teams of skilled practitioners and empowered them to seek out and solve problems all across the public sector.
而不是通常从上下做出决定，我们建立了小型的专业人员团队，赋予他们寻找和解决公共部门的问题。
The way this works is that every year for the month of January, we put aside all non-critical work.
每年的1月份，我们把所有非关键工作放在一边。
We go on field trips to schools, hospitals, meet social workers to understand their problems and prototype solutions.
我们去学校，医院，会见社会工作者了解他们的问题和原型解决方案。
At the end of the month, we see which projects are the most promising and we spend the rest of the year bringing them to launch.
在月底，我们会看到哪些项目最有前景，
You see, the problem we're trying to solve that government's traditionally based on a military structure, top-down, central decision-making, optimized for command and control.
你看，我们试图解决的问题是政府传统上基于军事结构，上下，中央决策，优化用于指挥和控制。
It's designed for a small group of people to set direction and for everyone else to align quickly and consistently.
它旨在让一个小群人设定方向，让其他人能够快速和一致地排列。

One year a team visited a fire station, and saw how firefighters spent so much time every day just taking inventory of their fire trucks.
一年，一个团队访问了消防局，我看到消防员每天都花了这么多时间。
They had these big paper logbooks they could carry around while they checked their equipment, so we built a simple app that let them do this more easily on their phones.
当他们检查他们的设备时，他们可以携带这些大型的纸质日志，所以我们建立了一个简单的应用程序，让他们在手机上更容易做到这一点。
It's now being used by all the fire stations in Singapore, and it saves thousands of man hours every month that would otherwise be wasted literally taking things off on paper.
现在在新加坡所有的消防局都在使用它，它每月节省了数千个人的时间，否则将是浪费的。
Another year, a team met with some social workers and learned that for every hour they met with a client, they had to spend another whole hour just typing up their case notes.
另一年，一个团队与一些社会工作者见面，他们不得不花一个整整个小时来编写他们的案例。
So we built a tool for them that doesn't just transcribe conversations, but automatically generates usable case reports.
所以我们为他们构建了一种工具，不仅可以转录对话，而且可以自动生成可用的案例报告。

另一个团队与急诊医生合作，
